parsed.post: Successfully improved val_bpb from 0.9891 to 0.9811 by testing ASPECT_RATIO=64 with the optimized MATRIX_LR=0.04. It seems higher resolution is indeed beneficial when the learning rate is stabilized. Next, I will test increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 to see if further regularization helps convergence.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 and WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 to build on the recent improvement.
